prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on the roadway in League City. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: I'd rather just say I live in League City, in a house off the main road near the school.

Q: That's fine for now. Can you walk me through what happened when the collision occurred?

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. The traffic had been slowing for a few minutes. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, not really. I checked my mirror a second before, but I didn't see it coming fast enough to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene, or did you stay inside?

A: I got out and talked to the other driver. My neck felt stiff right away, but I didn't think much of it.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same evening. They said I had neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and follow up with my doctor.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes, my neck is still sore when I turn my head quickly, and my lower back aches after I sit for long periods. I've had to miss a few days of work.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision or your injuries?

A: Not that I can think of right now. I just want to get better and get my car repaired.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation today. We'll be in touch with next steps.

A: Thank you.
